claims.head: The matchup inside the matchup
claims.body: The Mammoth are one of the league’s best for shot volume, but the Oilers are near the top at keeping shots away. Our lean: the Mammoth’s shot volume wins out.

claims.head: There’s no curse: Vejmelka vs. The Oilers
claims.body: Since 2023-24, Vejmelka has been shaky against the Oilers, well below his usual. Fans love a pattern like this, but we checked three seasons of them and they predicted nothing. Don’t be surprised if he’s back to his usual self.
claims.nums: 6 starts against Edmonton: .849 save percentage · .899 against everyone else
claims.gist: Don’t read much into Vejmelka’s record against the Oilers.
claims.call: If Vejmelka starts, his save percentage lands closer to his usual .899 than to his .849 against the Oilers.

claims.head: Depth vs. Star power
claims.body: The Mammoth roll four lines, but the Oilers lean on their top six. Utah is the league’s best for depth, and Edmonton is one of the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. If this one comes down to the bottom six, that suits the Mammoth.

EDM.head: Leaning the Oilers’ way
EDM.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. Edmonton has home-ice advantage. The Mammoth can still swing it if they keep shots to a minimum.

UTA.head: Close, but the Oilers have the slight edge
UTA.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. Edmonton has home-ice advantage. The Mammoth’s best way to tip it is keeping shots to a minimum.

story.head: The Oilers come in hot
paras: The Oilers have won five straight, and they’re rolling. The Mammoth have won two in a row.

items.text: The Oilers are newly without Frederik Andersen, and have had to make do without Zach Hyman, Ryan Nugent-Hopkins and Matt Savoie all season. Devon Levi is expected to start.
Connor McDavid has a point in six straight games against Utah, with a goal in each of the last four, and 13 points in his last six against them.
The Mammoth are newly without Michael Carcone.
Vasily Podkolzin has a point in every game this season, with a goal in each of the last three.
